craft_notes: Sthāyin: deem-joy. Close: indwelling. Rejected: 'pantheism' — killed.

lines: Śiva, all-bounded by the boundless, high
deemed the power-triad; what on the pure path stands thereby.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam tadantarvarti yatkiñcit śuddhamārge vyavasthitam |

reads_against.argmap: Boundless-ended Śiva, supreme triad deemed; whatever stands on the pure path inside that.
c1_essence: Boundless Śiva, supreme triad; pure-path standers inside.
